title: A gap report
heading: Round 1: The Search Brackets the Optimum Between Two Numbers
cases: a maximization's gaps divide the absolute gap by the incumbent
the absolute gap is positive whichever side the bound is on
SCIP's convention divides by the smaller of the two numbers in size
with no plan every entry of the report is None
an incumbent of zero gives no relative gap, never a huge number
a plan with no proven bound has an infinite gap, never None
